name: list-pending-actions
description: List pending approval requests awaiting the principal's decision: actions held for approval. Returns number, short_ref, description, skill name and expiry for each, and question for a personal-data ask (what the principal was asked). Call it when the principal answers an approval or asks what is pending. Match their words to a request by its description or question ("yes, share it with Dana" → the ask naming Dana), then pass its number as short_ref (its short_ref if number is null) to approve-action, deny-action, or dismiss-action (dismiss when the principal handled it outside Curia). With one request pending, short_ref can be omitted. If it is unclear which one they mean, show the list and ask.
